hooks.name: code-quest-session-start
hooks.description: Standing rules and team status: open pull requests, who owns them, what changed on main

hooks.name: code-quest-agent-guard
hooks.description: Blocks --no-verify, force-pushes to main, and merging a pull request the other person has not approved

hooks.name: code-quest-handbrake
hooks.description: Past about 600k tokens, allows only reading and writing the handover

hooks.name: code-quest-before-agent
hooks.description: Short-answers rule, long-chat warnings, and the handover order at about 400k and 600k tokens

hooks.name: code-quest-pre-compress
hooks.description: Tells the user that compression drops detail and suggests a handover
